name: Transform HTML to Markdown
short_descr: Transform origin's HTML responses to Markdown format when request header "Accept" is equal to "text/markdown". Particularly useful for AI Agents.
long_descr:
In CDN resource configuration assign the application to `On request headers`, `On response headers` and `On response body` FastEdge handlers.

Template source is available here: [FastEdge-templates/html2md](https://github.com/G-Core/FastEdge-templates/tree/main/html2md)
